name: Tasks
description: Tasks component with package screens for lists, priority views, task editing, subtasks, tags, activity, focus, at-risk, overdue and summary reads. Full legacy parity remains unfinished.

navigation.label: Tasks
navigation.description: View tasks by list or priority, edit tasks, and manage subtasks, tags and comments. Account timezone, People, assistant policies and background jobs remain unfinished.

features.description: Tasks component with validated task, list, tag, activity, view preference and ordered breakdown routes. Nineteen tool handlers cover six reads and thirteen task, list, tag, activity and breakdown actions. Full parity, assistant action policies and background jobs remain unfinished.

errors.description: A request has missing or invalid fields. Correct the field named in the validation message and retry.
A task or list is absent or unavailable to this account.
A data operation failed; internal details are withheld from the response.

features.description: Package screen using the shared UI kit, authored typography and parent bridge: task loading; list and priority views; status, list, text and tag filters; create and edit tasks; completion and suggestion review; list creation and renaming; subtasks; tag creation and assignment; activity comments; saved default view. Dates currently display in UTC. Full legacy screen and setting parity is unfinished.

remediations.description: Retry loading Tasks after checking the connection. Unsaved editor fields are retained on request failure.

errors.description: Tasks could not load or save a request. Check the connection and retry.

features.description: Manage lists opens each list's tags. Create or rename tags, then assign them from task details. Deleting requires confirmation and removes the tag from the list's tasks while keeping the tasks. Unsaved tag names are retained after request failures and protected when returning to lists. These controls use the existing account-scoped tag routes.

Task actions preserve tool-entered text, return legacy result summaries, and run in the account-scoped host transaction. Breakdown preserves step order and adds parent activity; the HTTP route trims steps. The host requires account approval for each tool invocation. Legacy automatic-action policies, presentations and installed chat integration remain unfinished.

errors.description: A tool input has missing fields or incorrect types. Correct the action inputs and retry.

features.description: Enqueue a status change for a visible task and apply it in the captured account context. The host supplies actor identity and metadata-only parameters. Queue retries and retention use host defaults; legacy queue options, optional request-key retention and recurrence jobs remain unfinished.

Read up to twenty owned open tasks due within a bounded horizon, including overdue tasks, with material revisions and the next time boundary. Shared tasks are excluded and recurrence is never advanced. Background authorization and scheduler integration remain unfinished.

The tasks.list tool filters visible persisted tasks by list, tag, status, priority, strict date/completion boundaries and priority quadrant, preserving updated-time/identifier ordering and tag data. Explicit shares remain visible; private tasks remain hidden from other accounts including admins. Actor-local lazy recurrence and installed chat integration remain unfinished. Correct invalid filter types or date text and retry.

Manage lists offers confirmed deletion, optionally moving every task and subtask to another owned list. Tasks are kept and assignments to tags outside the destination are removed. The last list cannot be deleted, including by concurrent package requests. The same behavior is available through tasks.deleteList. Legacy automatic approvals and installed chat integration remain unfinished.

errors.description: The list is not empty or is the last list. Choose another list to keep the tasks, or create another list first.

remediations.description: Choose a different owned list as the destination before confirming deletion of a nonempty list.

features.description: Focus, at-risk and overdue routes and tools, plus a bounded twelve-row summary tool, read persisted tasks in the signed-in account scope. Private tasks stay hidden from other accounts including admins. Focus returns no external readiness signals in the package, so no readiness cap is applied. Days use UTC and recurring series are not advanced until the public actor-timezone seam exists.

tasks.get.description: Get a task with its subtasks and ten most recent activity entries.

tasks.listTags.description: List tags in a task list.

tasks.create.description: Create a task owned by the signed-in account.

tasks.update.description: Update a visible task using the current account permissions.

tasks.updateStatus.description: Complete, archive or reopen a task.

tasks.breakDown.description: Break an owned task into ordered subtasks.

tasks.addActivity.description: Add a note or activity entry to a visible task.

tasks.assignTag.description: Assign an owned tag to an owned task.

tasks.unassignTag.description: Remove a tag from an owned task.

tasks.createList.description: Create a task list for the signed-in account.

tasks.createTag.description: Create a tag in an owned task list.

tasks.heartbeatWindow.description: Read a bounded owner-only overdue/due-soon window and revision without advancing recurrence. Background scheduler integration remains unfinished.

tasks.list.description: List visible persisted tasks with list, tag, status, priority, date, completion and quadrant filters. Actor-local recurrence reconciliation remains unfinished.

tasks.deleteList.description: Delete an owned task list, optionally moving its tasks to another owned list. The last list is kept; a nonempty list requires a destination.

tasks.summary.description: Read a bounded summary of today, overdue, upcoming, undated, completed or all tasks. Persisted occurrences only; days are UTC until the actor-timezone seam exists.

tasks.focus.description: Get ranked overdue and at-risk tasks. Persisted occurrences only; days are UTC until the actor-timezone seam exists.

tasks.atRisk.description: Get tasks at risk of slipping (priority 3+, due within two days or do-date past, no completed subtask).

tasks.overdue.description: Get overdue open tasks, most overdue first.
